name: receipt-non-canonical
description: receipt-valid with ingest_schema_version encoded in two bytes (0x18 0x01) instead of one; the signature is the genuine one.
asserts: Verification re-derives the signed bytes from the parsed fields, so a lenient parser would verify the signature over bytes other than those received and accept this receipt. The receipt carries its signature inline, so a non-canonical receipt must be refused at parse, before verification. parse_error names the reason; the expectation's other fields only say that nothing here acknowledges the upload.
